tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Window background behind the three columns, and the title bar.

tokens.name: terminal-well
tokens.usage: Background of the terminal and of every xterm.js instance; also the terminal theme's background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Side panels: the explorer, the Map panel, the Extensions menu.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, Ticket nodes, inputs, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Selected row, active tab, popovers and dialogs.

tokens.name: contour
tokens.usage: The faint contour-line pattern drawn behind the Map graph and on empty states. Decorative only, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel dividers, row separators, card edges that only group.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, toggles off, a blocked Ticket's dashed outline, graph edges. 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and titles on ground, surface, surface-raised and surface-overlay (12:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: Session subtitles, metadata, timestamps, closed Ticket names. 5:1 or more on every surface up to surface-overlay.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholders only (about 4:1 on surface, below the 4.5:1 floor on purpose: never use it for text that must be read).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The accent. Primary buttons, the focus of attention in the Map: Frontier Tickets, the Ticket the displayed Session works on, the active tab's underline. Text in brass reads on every surface (7:1 or more).

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind Frontier Ticket nodes and the primary button's hover halo.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brass fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring on every control, solid, 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: route
tokens.usage: Claude at work: the 'working' Session status, claimed Tickets, links. Text in route reads on every surface (7:1).

tokens.name: route-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind claimed Ticket nodes and working status pills.

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: A Session waiting for the user (permission prompt, question). Always paired with the waiting glyph and the word, because brass sits close in hue.

tokens.name: waiting-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the waiting status pill.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: A finished turn or Session, a closed Ticket's check mark, a connected MCP server. Always with a glyph or word.

tokens.name: done-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the done status pill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Delete) and errors: an MCP server that failed, Claude Code not found. Always with a glyph or word, never told from done by hue alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind error banners and the danger button's hover.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection in the terminal and in panels.

tokens.name: ansi-black
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 0.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 1 (removed lines in diffs, errors).

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 2 (added lines in diffs).

tokens.name: ansi-yellow

tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 4.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 5.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 6.

tokens.name: ansi-white
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 7.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-black
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 8 (dim text, Claude Code's hints).

tokens.name: ansi-bright-red
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 9.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-green
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 10.

tokens.name: ansi-bright-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 11.

tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI 12.

styles.name: text-heading
styles.usage: Project names in the explorer, section headings in panels.

styles.name: text-body

styles.name: text-body-strong

styles.usage: The displayed Session's title, the selected Ticket.

styles.name: text-small

styles.name: text-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase panel labels: SESSIONS, MAP, EXTENSIONS, DESTINATION.

styles.name: mono-code
styles.usage: Commands, paths and ids shown in panels and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel side padding, Ticket node padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panel sections, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between graph ranks; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between Tickets in one graph rank.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, status pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, rows, tabs, Ticket nodes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and count badges.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Height of the window title bar with the session tabs.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Height of an explorer row and an Extensions row.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: size-explorer
tokens.usage: Default explorer width (resizable 200 to 420).

tokens.name: size-map
tokens.usage: Default Map panel width (resizable 320 to 720).

tokens.name: size-ticket
tokens.usage: Width of a Ticket node in the graph.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs above the panels.

tokens.name: shadow-node-lift
tokens.usage: A hovered workable Ticket node.
